name: Alfoz de Santa Gadea (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of blue, red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alfoz de Santa Gadea (a saint on blue, a tree on yellow and an oak with a cow).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by the council of Alfoz de Santa Gadea in plenary on 14 December 2006 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 89 of 9 May 2007); the flag is square, 1:1, with the municipal arms at its heart.

features.role: Alfoz de Santa Gadea arms — saint, tree and oak with a cow
